title: Reported Statements: Shift or Stay
goal: Review reported statements after a past verb and learn when the verb can stay as it was.
grammar: Reported statements: backshift, and when the original tense can stay

items: I can report what someone said and move the verb back (dijo que tenía, había llegado, llegaría).
I can keep the present when what was said is still true, or after a reporting verb in the present.
I can use the new words for still, valid, coming true and agreeing.
